monitoring_priorities: Safety and functionality of hospitals, puskesmas, laboratories and referral routes.
Trauma care, wound management, tetanus risk assessment and continuity of essential medicines.
Safe water, sanitation, hygiene and health conditions in evacuation locations.
Syndromic surveillance for diarrhoea, respiratory illness, fever, skin disease and unusual events.
Mental-health and psychosocial support, including continuity of care for vulnerable groups.
